review_candidates.title: Project Accountant
review_candidates.description: Summary The Project Accountant at Megawatt Construction is responsible for supporting the financial management and accounting activities of large-scale data center construction projects. This role focuses on maintaining accurate project financial records, monitoring job costs, processing project-related transactions, and supporting billing, accounts payable, and accounts receivable functions. The Project Accountant works closely with project managers, the Controller, and other accounting team members to ensure project financials are accurate, current, and aligned with established budgets and company procedures. Essential Functions Project Accounting & Job Costing: Maintain accurate financial records for assigned construction projects, including job cost tracking, cost coding, expense allocation, and reconciliation of project-related accounts. Accounts Payable & Receivable: Review and process project-related vendor invoices, subcontractor payments, customer billings, and receivables. Verify proper coding, supporting documentation, approvals, and payment terms. Project Billing: Prepare and process customer invoices, including AIA billing and schedule of values, ensuring accuracy and compliance with contract requirements and billing deadlines. Budget & Cost Monitoring: Assist with tracking project budgets, commitments, actual costs, and cost-to-complete information. Identify discrepancies and communicate potential cost issues to project managers and accounting leadership. Work in Progress (WIP) Reporting: Support monthly WIP reporting by maintaining accurate project financial data, reviewing costs and billings, and assisting with analysis of project performance and financial status. Reconciliations & Month-End Close : Perform account reconciliations, review project transactions, assist with month-end closing activities, and ensure financial information is recorded accurately and timely. Change Orders & Contract Documentation: Track approved change orders, subcontractor commitments, and contract modifications to ensure project accounting records reflect current project scope and financial obligations. Financial Reporting & Documentation: Prepare project financial reports, maintain organized accounting records, and provide supporting documentation for internal reviews, audits, and management reporting. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with project managers, project administrators, procurement, and the accounting team to resolve invoice discrepancies, obtain required documentation, and maintain accurate project financial information. Position Requirements Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably within the construction industry or a project-based environment. Accounting Knowledge: Working knowledge of construction accounting principles, including job costing, WIP reporting, AIA billing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger reconciliations. Software Skills: Proficiency with accounting software such as Sage, Viewpoint, or similar ERP systems, along with strong Microsoft Excel skills. Analytical Skills : Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to analyze financial information, identify discrepancies, and resolve accounting issues. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with project managers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal accounting personnel. Time Management : Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced construction environment. Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant accounting experience may be considered. Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of accounting experience, with construction or project accounting experience strongly preferred.
